meta.title: NUMBER ONE — POLIJE × KNU, Jember 2026
meta.description: 2026 WFK IT Volunteer Corps, Kyungpook National University Team 01. Nine people from Korea and Indonesia built and shipped PlantMoji, a smart-farming learning game, during 22 days in Jember.
hero.eyebrow: 2026 WFK IT Volunteer Corps · KNU Team 01
hero.lede: For 22 days between 27 July and 17 August 2026, nine people from POLIJE and Kyungpook National University built and shipped PlantMoji in Jember, Indonesia. Both sides committed to each other's repositories, and what we built is still running.
team.title: One team, two countries, four roles
team.lede: This was not one side teaching and the other learning. Both countries staffed the same four roles — PL · TL · KL · ML — and worked in matched pairs.
team.role.PL.desc: Set scope and schedule, and brokered decisions between the two sides.
team.role.TL.desc: Designed the architecture and wrote the code.
team.role.KL.desc: Designed the teaching material and the agronomy behind it.
team.role.ML.desc: Made the design, the record, and the outreach.
team.note: Member introductions and photographs will be added once everyone has given consent.
shipped.title: What we shipped
shipped.lede: This is the part the presentation had no time for. All five exist. Two of them you can open right now.
shipped.web.name: PlantMoji web app
shipped.web.tagline: Sensor readings become a mood, and the mood becomes a quest.
shipped.web.body: A sensor reading turns into a plant's mood, and that mood issues a care quest. When you actually water the plant, the next reading verifies it, and success pays out XP, bond levels and badges. The mascot is called Jamkachu, after Jember.
shipped.web.note: The sensor hardware stayed in Jember and has been powered down since 20 August 2026. The readings you see are the real data collected up to that point.
shipped.mobile.name: Mobile PlantEmoji
shipped.mobile.tagline: An Indonesian-built client running on a Korean-built server.
shipped.mobile.body: Five Flutter screens poll the Korean team's backend every ten seconds. The plant sprite grows through four stages driven by the level the server computes, and the mood collection and grow diary share the same state as the web app. The camera scan re-encodes JPEG at quality 72, 60, 48 and 36 until the upload fits a 195 KB budget.
shipped.mobile.note: The point is not that we also built an app. The point is that two clients built in two countries share one game state.
shipped.design.name: Pixel farm design & 300 sprites
shipped.design.tagline: An Indonesian teammate's design became the product's home screen.
shipped.design.body: Reno's cozy pixel-farm layout did not stay a reference. It became the actual home screen of the web app — the shell component is named reno-app-shell, and the handover document fixes that design as the immutable visual source of truth. Kiki drew the plant sprites across four growth stages and five moods, eight mood badges, and six NPCs named in Bahasa Indonesia.
shipped.design.note: The colours and the pixel feel of this very page come from that same design system.
shipped.camera.name: Camera AI
shipped.camera.tagline: An image classifier that runs inside the browser.
shipped.camera.body: A two-class model with a MobileNetV2 backbone runs directly in the browser and re-classifies the view every 2.5 seconds. Below 0.70 confidence it declines to give a verdict at all. The video never leaves the device.
shipped.camera.note: It learned the scene it was trained on, so in a different setting it will usually report an unfamiliar environment. It does not identify plant disease or species.
shipped.nodered.name: LeafTalk decision engine
shipped.nodered.tagline: Where a sensor reading turns into a feeling.
shipped.nodered.body: A Node-RED flow translates readings into mood states. Separate on and off thresholds keep the state — and the servo — from oscillating when a value sits on the boundary, and gaps in the data award no XP. Commands are unified so branch ordering cannot race, and LCD output is clipped to 16 characters.
shipped.nodered.note: The sensor watchdog and the secret-handling rules are written into the flow comments too.
codev.title: Proof that we built it together
codev.lede: Plenty of teams say international collaboration. Few can show it in a commit log. We can show it in both directions.
codev.org.label: Where the repositories live
codev.org.desc: Both institutions are written into the organisation name. All three repositories are public.
codev.dir1.label: Indonesia → Korean repository
codev.dir1.desc: Revi Ardiano delivered the on-site retrained Camera AI model straight into the Korean codebase. The background-music subsystem is Indonesian-authored too.
codev.dir2.label: Korea → Indonesian repository
codev.dir2.desc: The Korean side wired the Flutter app to the PlantMoji APIs and made bond level and sensor state render for real.
codev.shared.label: One shared state
codev.shared.desc: The mobile app's /api/* calls are forwarded to the Korean server. Both clients see the same level, XP and streak.
codev.honest.title: The part we are not hiding
codev.honest.body: The contribution volume is lopsided. Most of the web app's 280 commits are Korean, and most of the mobile app's 17 commits are Indonesian. Accurately described, each side led its own artefact and committed meaningfully into the other's. That is the truth, and it holds up better than a claim of an even split would.
retrain.eyebrow: The scene that explains this team
retrain.title: We retrained it in the field
retrain.lede: What we built got it wrong in a real greenhouse. So before we packed up and flew home, we trained it again on site.
retrain.step1.title: First training
retrain.step1.body: We trained and exported the image classifier on location in Jember.
retrain.step2.title: Wrong in the real greenhouse
retrain.step2.body: The growing environment did not look like the scene we had trained on, and the model would not call a safe environment safe.
retrain.step3.title: Retrained and redeployed
retrain.step3.body: We trained it again on site and shipped it into the product. The backbone stayed; only the classifier changed.
retrain.viz.title: What actually changed
retrain.viz.caption: Of 263 weight tensors, 3 changed — all of them in the classifier head. The 410,208 backbone parameters were left alone; only the part that makes the judgement was taught again.
arch.title: From a sensor to a feeling
arch.lede: Instead of showing the raw value, we translate it into a mood. A number has to be learned before it can be read; a thirsty face does not.
arch.n1d: Soil moisture · temperature · humidity · light · pH
arch.note: The sensor hardware remains in Jember and is currently powered down. This pipeline ran on real measurements through August 2026.
ground.title: On the ground
ground.lede: We were in Jember for 22 days. What stayed with us is as much the people as the thing we built.
